dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.internal.dialogfield.refresh.validate>
<!description: After refreshing a DialogField, ensure its validation is triggered.
This rule applies to internal Eclipse UI components (org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.wizards.dialogfields.DialogField and its subtypes).>
<!severity: HINT>
$x.refresh() :: instanceof($x, "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.wizards.dialogfields.DialogField")
=>
$x.refresh()
$x.dialogFieldChanged()
;;
summary: Adds `dialogFieldChanged()` call after `refresh()` on `DialogField` instances to trigger immediate UI validation. This applies only to types derived from `org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.wizards.dialogfields.DialogField`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
